pages.text:
Sulphur cap: bitter oil below the cap. Don't eat raw. The headache is the least of it.

Prophet's eye: crush with a wet stone. The liquid is useful. The cap is nothing.

Murk violet stem: dry it first. Three weeks minimum. Fresh juice is dangerous. Works on wounds that won't close.

Coldbell: handle with cloth. Don't breathe the powder. I don't know why but it gets in you.
